title: factory-conductor phase notes
description: What a phase agent leaves when it exits, while its context is fresh. factory-reflect reads these instead of the transcript. Evidence is a pointer, never pasted content.

summary.description: One line: what the phase did.

source.description: Set by end: measured when it read the run's session log, self when the numbers are the phase's own.

model.description: Measured: the model most of the run's messages came from.

model_ms.description: Measured: time from each tool result to the model's next message, summed.

subagents.description: Measured: subagents the run started, by model.

friction.description: What slowed the phase: retries, wrong assumptions, a tool that failed.

misses.description: Something an earlier phase should have caught.

question.description: With outcome blocked: the one decision the conductor or user must make.

evidence.description: Pointers: a commit, PR thread, file:line, transcript path and grep words.

handoff.description: Fields this phase sets in state.json for the next one.

ticket.description: Set by intake when it files the ticket on a plan-first run.

base.description: The branch the PR targets: trunk, or the parent's branch when stacked. Deploy sets it.

feature_entry.description: The feature map entry the phases read and extend: the map's own file when this repo owns the map, else the ticket's draft under <stateRoot>/feature-map/. Intake sets it.
